summary: This CSS defines styling for an AI icon badge and its inner icon element. The badge uses flexbox to arrange a small icon next to text with consistent spacing and a dark border, while the icon itself is constrained to a small 16x16 pixel square.

explanations.2: inline-flex makes this element sit inline with text (like a word) but uses flexbox rules internally to arrange its children
explanations.3: align-items: center vertically centers the icon and text within the badge
explanations.5: gap: 8px adds 8 pixels of space between the icon and any text next to it
explanations.6: This references a CSS variable (--ifm-color-primary-dark) which is a dark color defined elsewhere, likely by the theme
